newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Julius Meinl buys Poland's Major SA.
newsitem.headline: Julius Meinl buys Poland's Major SA.

text.p: Austrian supermarket chain Julius Meinl International AG said on Friday it had acquired a 51 percent stake in Polish supermarket group Major SA .
Major SA has five branches in southern Poland with 450 employees. The group reported sales of 240 million schillings in 1996.
Meinl hopes to open five more Major SA branches in 1997, raising turnover to an estimated 450 million schillings.
The company aims to open 40 supermarkets in Poland by the year 2000, which it hopes would bring in sales of two billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
